mathematical-foundations.read: Select a concept to change the spatial representation: a contracted index across matrices, a rank-one projection, normalized probabilities, the seven bits of an E3M3 teaching number, or a Binomial(12, 0.5) distribution. Spatial height encodes the named quantity, not a physical scale. The mathematical foundations experience exposes exact values and interventions.

data-evidence-foundations.read: Source cards separate into three colored destination stacks while connecting lines retain identity. This is an orientation to lineage and partitioning; the depicted card count is illustrative. The corpus experience exposes actual example IDs, token masks and split membership.

contrasting-ai-methods.read: The selected concept changes the structure: a branching additive-tree or search representation, or four nodes exchanging messages. Geometry denotes an algorithmic relationship, not physical containment. Exact fitted values, messages and searched outcomes are available in the foundations experience.

model-lifecycle-base-model.read: Follow token-feature arrays into a triangular causal-attention pattern, projection matrices and a residual path. Array sizes here illustrate indexing and masking; the model experience shows the actual 423 parameters and all intermediate values. Layer spacing is conceptual.

model-lifecycle-pretraining.read: Follow token-feature arrays into a triangular causal-attention pattern, projection matrices and a residual path. model-lifecycle-continuation.read: A causal block sits beside a two-factor adaptation branch. The geometry locates parameters, state and possible update paths; it does not imply that every post-training technique uses low-rank adapters. Read the selected stage contract, then use the model experience for the actual objective and trainable state.

model-lifecycle-evaluation.read: Evidence cards produce candidate results, which pass an independent checking boundary before a task outcome. Colors separate these roles; they do not assert that any particular output is correct. Read the selected metric and denominator or inspect the named executable evaluation.

model-lifecycle-multimodal.read: Patch planes and sampled-signal points enter modality projections and shared representation arrays. These are distinct input structures, not physical layers or a claim that every modality uses the same encoder. The selected lesson specifies its actual objective, shape and evidence.

model-lifecycle-world-action.read: An observed state feeds a branching prediction tree. One action changes a simulated object and closes the observation loop. The control experience supplies actual fitted parameters, selected actions, delayed measurements and checked outcomes; this orientation is not a physical robot.

embodied-observation-action.read: An observed state feeds a branching prediction tree. One action changes a simulated object and closes the observation loop. The control experience supplies actual fitted parameters, selected actions, delayed measurements and checked outcomes; this orientation is not a physical robot.

evaluated-application-families.read: Source records become candidate results and cross a separate evidence check before a task outcome. This is the common application boundary, not an assertion that ranking, forecasting and code evaluation use the same model or metric. Each lesson states its own task contract.

process-cell-bridge.read: A schematic complementary device pair shares an input and drives a load. The enlarged gate dielectric and capacitive load expose distinct physical roles. Geometry is conceptual; the electrical experience computes the named long-channel specimen, transfer curve and timed transition.
